notes: The supplied he of the verbless causal clause resumes the earlier written אָסָא (rule 25); the competing reading marks it added. בֵּית הַמַּהְפֶּכֶת → in the prison house: bare construct takes the supplied in (rule 33), the fronted the goes to the rectum's article (rule 29). בָּעֵת הַהִיא → at the same time gives the to the assimilated article and same to the demonstrative (rules 12, 41).
